queries.note: Retirement clears is_current. The publication is retired as well.

queries.question: Which warehouse ships replacement lamps?
queries.note: Both current articles tie. Retrieval returns both, ordered by title. It does not pick a winner.

queries.question: Show only the two closest articles.
queries.note: Alpha also clears 0.3. topK 2 drops it.

queries.question: What did the pasted note say?

queries.question: What happened to the failed index?
queries.note: A published current row is still hidden when ingestion did not succeed.
